body.message:
The 1BR in Upside Living is AED 7,000/month, all-inclusive. That covers VAT, water, electricity, and internet, so nothing extra to pay beyond the deposit.

One thing worth knowing: it's an adults-only building, so no children are permitted.

For a 1-year stay, rates are confirmed in 3-month blocks. The first block locks in at AED 7,000/month, and each following period is confirmed ahead of time based on the season. Would you like to come see the apartment before we sort the details?
